options.name: Now
options.line: The list I'd fix first: seven rows of text, no guitar in sight.

options.name: The Wall
options.line: The seven hang in a row that travels sideways as you scroll, each with its number, three facts, a price and a way into the room.

options.name: Spotlight
options.line: Seven names on the left. Scrolling moves the light down the list and the guitar, its drawing and its sheet change on the right.

options.name: To Scale
options.line: All seven on a cream sheet at true size, lined up at the bridge. The light goes along the row and the others fall back to their drawings.
